tool_args.rationale: All five pilot rows are already at the target horizon H = 0.6, but s_grad spans only 0.018. Over that range, the siphon base depends mainly on the combined amplitude vmax × (1 − rho/2). The 2.0-cost probe adds the gradient variation needed to separate those parameters before fitting over the full fallback bounds.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the siphon base with a square-root branch on the pilot alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot can constrain the drive response, but its narrow gradient span makes the separate estimates of vmax and rho unreliable.
It costs more, and finer time resolution does not directly address the lack of gradient variation.
It does not vary the gradient needed to distinguish vmax from rho.
